page.overview:
Who is Brick Yardley?

Brick Yardley is a veteran racer who races for Vitoline. He is number 24.

Right before the race at Los Angeles International Speedway, Lightning McQueen witnesses Brick begging his sponsor not to fire him and let him keep racing, bringing up how long he has been racing and his two wins, but his sponsor claims he has made up his mind and will give his number to a next-generation racer named Chase Racelott. Lightning tries asking Bobby Swift about what is going on with Brick, only to find out that he has also been replaced by a next-generation racer, Daniel Swervez.
